assumptions: THIS INCREMENT CHANGES NO DECISION AND NO CODE. It corrects three sentences in this package's own open_blockers that were true when written and false afterwards, and it removes one that is fully discharged. Same defect class as commit 9aee8bb, which repaired six such sentences in a test helper; this is the manifest version of it.

ONE BLOCKER IS DISCHARGED AND THEREFORE REMOVED. It said RFC-2026-015 was Proposed and that DB-00 must neither start on DATA-DEC-02 nor merge on DATA-DEC-01 until the record was disposed. That record was disposed on 2026-09-04, DATA-DEC-01 as `app` and DATA-DEC-02 as the wrapper command contract; read the RFC's status line for its wording rather than this file. DB-00 has since built and merged on both -- db/foundation/migrations/000_foundation.sql through 140_audit.sql and the Makefile command contract are on main -- so the blocker is not stale, it is spent, and it leaves open_blockers instead of being reworded.

THE OTHER THREE ARE CORRECTED RATHER THAN DROPPED, because each had a true half. The DATA-DEC-03 referral is discharged while the QUESTION it referred is not, and RFC-2026-022 §5/8's measurement is why: the only member of app_worker is postgres, which bypasses row level security. prefer_cross_vendor_review is untouched by any disposition. G0's restriction still stands while the clause that justified it -- "which a Proposed decision record is" -- stopped being true.

amends_without_owning IS EMPTIED, and that is a change to a record rather than an oversight. It carried five paths from this package's earlier increment; this branch touches none of them, and verify-branch-scope refuses a declaration that explains nothing the branch changed. The five are named in the manifest's new rationale and remain in git history.

STATUS IS DELIBERATELY NOT MOVED: this package stays in_progress. An Author may move work only as far as in_review, and doing so would be a claim about completeness rather than the correction of a false sentence, which is all this increment is.

acceptance_results.criterion: Every corrected sentence was checked against the artifact it describes
acceptance_results.evidence: RFC-2026-015's status line carries a disposition dated 2026-09-04. RFC-2026-016 §4 and RFC-2026-017's status line carry the partial DATA-DEC-03 closure. RFC-2026-022 §5/8 carries the app_worker measurement. evidence/g0-tracker-th.md still reads Specification Baseline Complete / External Verification Pending.

acceptance_results.criterion: A blocker is removed only when spent, not when merely inconvenient
acceptance_results.evidence: One of four removed; three kept with the false clause corrected and the correction stated inside the blocker, so a reader sees what moved and why.

acceptance_results.criterion: No decision, code, migration, contract or status changes
acceptance_results.evidence: Two files, both owned by this package under ownership.writable_paths: its own manifest and this handoff.

tests.result: see evidence/VERIFICATION.md; this increment adds no test and changes no count
both changed paths are owned by this package and no amendment is declared

security_privacy_cost_impact: None. No code, schema, grant, policy, role or contract is touched.
known_limitations: NOTHING PREVENTS THE NEXT STALE SENTENCE. A blocker list is prose and no lint reads English. The control that would catch this class ties a blocker naming a decision record to that record's status, and it is not written here -- WP-0A-DB-00 reached the same conclusion about position claims and gave the same reason: a lint that reads English will be wrong about English.

THREE SIBLING PACKAGES CARRY THE SAME DEFECT AND ARE NOT FIXED HERE. WP-0A-A0-007, -008 and -009 each hold blockers a disposition falsified. Each manifest is owned by its own package, so each correction is its own increment on its own declared branch; the audit for all four is in this handoff's recommended_next_work_packages.

THIS BRANCH IS CUT FROM main, WHICH DOES NOT YET CARRY THE QUADRATIC-STRIP FIX, so npm run check takes about fourteen minutes here rather than forty seconds. That is a property of the base, not of this increment.

THE TALLY IN THIS HANDOFF'S SIBLINGS WAS OFF BY ONE CLASS. Across the four packages the counts were reported as 6 spent / 7 corrected / 6 untouched; measured, they are 6 / 8 / 5, because this package's prefer_cross_vendor_review blocker gained a sentence and was counted as untouched. The original clause is preserved verbatim so the substance is unaffected -- only the arithmetic was wrong, which is the same class of defect as everything else this increment repairs.

amends_without_owning CARRIED A DANGLING `recorded_on` AND IT IS NOW REMOVED. It named work-packages/WP-0A-A0-002.json as the register holding the amendment record; that register's ownership.amended_by has entries for WP-0A-A0-005, WP-0A-CON-007 and WP-0A-CON-008 and never for this package. The reference was dangling before this branch and became meaningless once `paths` was emptied.

REBASED ONTO ff12b8b AFTER PR #104 MERGED, AND THAT MOVED THE GROUND UNDER THIS INCREMENT'S OWN SENTENCES. The base this branch declares now carries batch 070, so any count taken at f3d3102 is stale by exactly the five tables, seventy-three cases and sixteen service ids that batch adds. Every figure in this package was re-measured at the new base rather than carried across, which is the third time in this increment's life that the same defect class had to be caught -- once by an independent check, once by CI, and once here by expecting it.
